question: With real trace requests only, where does Silica's scheduler (B1, Zone) lose time, and is the loss tied to the per-zone request queues?
trace: Fujitsu enterprise VDI block trace (Lee et al., SYSTOR'17), data/2016022211-LUN0.csv, reads only; same trace family as GAIA
system: IOConfig defaults: 1 reader, 8 rows x 80 slots, 8 Zone shuttles, buffer 8, contention hold 0.5 s
mapping_note: The trace has no platter locations. contiguous keeps address locality; hash_1gib removes it (each 1 GiB extent on a random platter).

burst.note: 400 consecutive trace reads all arriving at t=0 (order and sizes from the trace)

online.note: trace time axis stretched so the mean arrival rate equals load x the B1 burst throughput of the same mapping; burst shape kept

metrics_note: restricted idle = shuttle idle while queued platters exist only in other zones
